sensitivePaths.label: Delete a repository
sensitivePaths.warning: The code and its history are gone.

agentGuide: Base path /api/v1, same as GitHub's shape. Me: GET /api/v1/user; my repos: GET /api/v1/user/repos; search: GET /api/v1/repos/search?q=<words>; one: GET /api/v1/repos/<owner>/<repo>. Issues: GET /api/v1/repos/<owner>/<repo>/issues?state=open, create: POST ... {"title": "...", "body": "..."}, comment: POST .../issues/<n>/comments {"body": "..."}. Pull requests: GET .../pulls; commits: GET .../commits?sha=main&limit=10; a file: GET .../contents/<path>?ref=main (base64 content); releases: GET .../releases. Create a repo: POST /api/v1/user/repos {"name": "...", "private": true}. The token's scopes bound what works. The token is set by Allkin.
